static_traits.name: Ke Wen
static_traits.family_status: Having 5 siblings, tense relationship with Mother due to recent events
static_traits.social_status: Having a few close friends to confide in, but not yet discussing this matter with them, worrying they cannot understand
static_traits.medical_history: Without significant physical illness; never received psychotherapy or counseling before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression in conversation, able to describe emotions and thoughts; Anxious and tense tone; actively cooperative, able to consider alternative outcomes and set specific goals under Guidance

basic_info.main_problem: I feel Mother favors my siblings more, especially since she missed my birthday last week to visit my sister, which gave me a sense of Being rejected and inferiority.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling after realizing these feelings of Being rejected are affecting my mental health and self-esteem, making it hard to cope with daily life.
growth_experiences: On my birthday last week, Mother did not attend my birthday to visit my sister; this event made me feel neglected and unloved, Reinforcement my long-standing feeling that Mother favors my siblings, and repeatedly triggering Being rejected and inferiority in later interactions.

A few days ago I found the stitching of my black wallet coming apart; because it holds strong emotional value, I worry about being unable to find an identical replacement, keep searching online fruitlessly, triggering Significant anxiety, difficulty concentrating, and worry about unbearable loss.

core_beliefs: I am not as good as my siblings

special_situations.event: Mother missing my birthday to visit my sister
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not get Mother's companionship and attention at important moments, it proves she does not love me and I am not as good as my siblings
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Directly communicating and arguing with Mother, trying to get Interpretation and confirmation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She will never love me the way she loves my siblings; I am not important

special_situations.event: Conversations with Mother often revolve around siblings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If conversations are always about siblings, it means I am neglected and not important
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing deep communication with Mother to avoid feeling Being rejected again, while not discussing these feelings with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She cares about them more; I am not really important in her heart

special_situations.event: The stitching of the black wallet has split and it is hard to find an identical replacement
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Losing an item with emotional value equals an unbearable loss; I will be unable to adapt
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly searching online for a replacement, repeatedly focusing and worrying
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never find the same one; I cannot face this loss

special_situations.event: Trying to talk to Mother about my feelings only triggered arguments and misunderstandings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express needs and feelings, others will misunderstand and negate me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: From now on, avoid discussing inner feelings with others to reduce conflict
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Saying it is useless; it will only get worse

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be loved and seen equally by Mother, gaining stable attention and recognition
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected and neglected, worrying about never measuring up to siblings
defense_goal: Maintains safety and avoids being hurt again by avoiding sharing and reducing in-depth communication
Proving self-worth and relieving unease through arguing and seeking reassurance

object_relations.self_representation: A neglected, unloved child (an unimportant self)
object_relations.object_representation: A biased Mother who neglects oneself
object_relations.linking_affect: Sense of Being rejected, inferiority, Anxiety

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others ask about Mother's favoritism and experiences of being neglected, or touch on relationship issues
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client subconsciously Displaces relational pain onto safer topics (such as the damaged wallet) to avoid directly facing feelings of being rejected by Mother (transference: projecting loss and Anxiety onto objects)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle and steady tone, first affirm the wallet's emotional value, then gradually connect to the interpersonal-rejection theme; use open-ended questions, avoid pressing, allow pauses.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Encountering arguments or misunderstandings when expressing one's needs or discussing feelings with Mother
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing expressing emotions brings negate and hurt, thus Turning anger and disappointment against the self to maintain surface stability in the relationship
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a supportive tone, labels the client's self-blame and invites the client to distinguish facts from feelings; provides emotion naming and grounding exercises, and encourages expressing with 'I-statements' rather than self-blame.

manifestations: Feeling Mother favors siblings, oneself not understood or seen
Daily experiencing Being rejected and unimportance in interactions involving Mother
Avoiding sharing true feelings with friends, worrying they will not understand

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: Shifting the conversation focus from the painful points of the Mother relationship to the wallet damage and replacement issue
Displacing Anxiety by constantly searching for replacements
In socializing, avoids talking to friends about real troubles

positive_force: Willing to proactively seek psychological counseling (positive attitude)
Can consider alternative outcomes and set concrete goals under guidance
Has a certain degree of social support (a few close friends)
negative_force: Tending toward cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking, overgeneralization, mind reading, and predicting the future
Impaired self-esteem, often feeling unloved and unimportant
Avoiding seeking support from friends, worrying others will not understand
Communication with Mother often falls into arguments and misunderstandings

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Anxiety and Self-denial in situations involving Mother
antecedent: Mother missing the birthday to visit the sister
Interactions with Mother revolving around siblings
target_behavior.core_reason: Highly sensitive to Being rejected and neglected, forming the core belief 'I am unloved/unimportant', triggering Self-denial upon encountering related cues
target_behavior.function: Avoiding rejection experiences, seeking Self-protection and a sense of control over relationships
target_behavior.consequence: Further tension in the relationship with Mother, Decreased self-esteem, affecting Work performance and sleep

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophic worry and persistent searching over losing an item of emotional value
antecedent: Finding the black wallet's stitching split open
Unable to find an identical replacement online
target_behavior.core_reason: Overly pinning emotions and security on objects; once damaged, catastrophizing and predicting inability to adapt
target_behavior.function: Trying to relieve Anxiety through control and replacement, avoiding facing the sense of loss
target_behavior.consequence: Distracted attention, difficulty focusing on tasks, Anxiety intensified
